title: 22家风投拒绝：Anthropic，如今排队等IPO，谁在后悔？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: An early anthropic investor who now runs AMP and AI Infrastructure Company, building compete capacity for Anthropic and other AI startups.
segments.zh: 一位早期**Anthropic的市场参与者，如今运营着AMP和AI基础设施公司，为Anthropic及其他AI初创企业建设竞争能力。

segments.en: And we have a lot to talk about today, but let's just start with Anthropic.
segments.zh: 今天我们有很多话题要聊，但让我们先从Anthropic开始。

segments.en: I was listening to this podcast where you talked about how when you were one of the founding investors in Anthropic over at Andreessen, you helped basically get them in front of 22 VCs
segments.zh: 我听了那个播客，你提到作为Anthropic的创始市场参与者之一，在Andreessen时，你帮助它接触了22家VC。

segments.en: and 21 of them said, no, what has it been like for you to watch this company, which at first couldn't get anyone on board to them to have everyone literally
segments.zh: 其中21家拒绝了。现在看到这家公司从最初无人问津，到现在人人都想参与，你有何感想？

segments.en: lining up the door for what might be a record-breaking IPO.
segments.zh: 甚至可能创纪录的IPO，门口排起了长队。

segments.en: Well, first off, thanks for having me back. It's always great to be here.
segments.zh: 首先，感谢再次邀请我。能来这里总是很棒。

segments.en: So yeah, to correct the record, I invested in Anthropic before I joined Andreessen Horace.
segments.zh: 所以，纠正一下，我在加入Andreessen Horowitz之前就**了Anthropic。

segments.en: Right, yes, you were an angel investor, thank you, Ange. Yes, and then the only reason I bring that up is because at the time, you know, unlike most institutional investors,
segments.zh: 对，你是天使市场参与者，谢谢。我之所以提这个，是因为当时与大多数机构市场参与者不同，

segments.en: I was an angel investor, and so I had the privilege to be to partner with the founders when we were all operators and fellow founders. I was running a company at the time.
segments.zh: 我是天使市场参与者，有幸与创始人合作，当时我们都是运营者和联合创始人。我当时经营一家公司。

segments.en: I just sold it to Discord, and I would say it was frustrating because those of us in the AI community, my previous AI business was called Ubiquity 6, and we all used to hang out in a machine
segments.zh: 我刚把它卖给了Discord。我想说，这很令人沮丧，因为AI社区里的人，我之前创办的AI公司叫Ubiquity6，我们经常在机器上聚会。

segments.en: learning community in San Francisco, and we were all just very technical. And so for those of us who understood what was happening with the science and who read the scaling laws paper that,
segments.zh: 在旧金山的学习社区里，我们都非常技术化。对于我们这些了解科学进展并读过缩放定律论文的人来说，

segments.en: you know, Tom and Dario and team put out in 2020, we just said, hey, this is very simple. It's a very
segments.zh: 就是汤姆、达里奥和团队在2020年发表的，我们当时就说，嘿，这很简单。
